scope: One h1/h2 IPv4 pair, no generated background; current measured-load admission, not a guarantee for arbitrary future bursts.
rate_note: Admission compares observed counter rates with a budget rounded below the lowest demonstrated 16M payload goodput; deliberately conservative. Nominal 20M is not used as a certified payload budget.
limitations: Three 20-second steady controls do not certify all burst peaks or maximum path service.
Admission uses recent observed load and must reject stale, down-link or over-budget conditions.
Counter freshness/event-target calibration and larger independent data remain separate open checkpoints.
